title: Galatine Prime
extract:
Galatine Prime is the Primed variant of the  Galatine heavy sword, boasting higher damage, critical chance, and status chance. It was released alongside  Nekros Prime and  Tigris Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matches  Cleaving Whirlwind and  Tempo Royale stances.
Two innate  polarities.

Acquisition

Vaultings
On June 5, 2018, it was announced that Galatine Prime, alongside  Nekros Prime and  Tigris Prime, would enter the Prime Vault and be retired from the reward tables on June 19, 2018. Any preexisting components or fully-built weapons will remain as is.

Notes
The Galatine Prime can be used to stun-lock enemies (a characteristic of heavy melee weapons), as well as land easy headshots with its overhead chops.
As with other heavies, the overhead chops cause small AoE damage.
The default stance of the Galatine Prime is that of an unranked  Tempo Royale.

Tips
The Galatine Prime can be built for either critical, status or even a hybrid of the two with equal effectiveness, giving players a lot of flexibility in modding their Galatine Primes.
Due to its  Slash damage, the Galatine Prime is well suited for use with a Desecrate  Nekros.

Trivia
The Galatine Prime's slam attack features more particle effects compared to its unprimed counterpart, though not as extreme as the  Jat Kittag.
"Galatine" is the name of the sword gifted to Sir Gawain (most well known for the chivalrous tale, "Sir Gawain and the Green Knight") by the Lady of the Lake in the Arthurian Legends.
